Organization: Career Launch Tech Initiative (CLTI)
Type: Volunteer
Location: Remote (with potential opportunities for on-site collaboration with partner companies)
Commitment: Flexible (20-25 hours per week recommended)


About CLTI:
Career Launch Tech Initiative (CLTI) is a 501(c)(3) nonprofit whose mission is to equip underserved communities with the technology, training, and resources necessary to access career development opportunities.


The Role:
CLTI is seeking a Volunteer Software Engineer to collaborate with one of our partner companies, providing pro-bono software engineering support on impactful projects. This is a unique opportunity to contribute your expertise to initiatives that drive social good while gaining hands-on experience and expanding your professional network.


Key Responsibilities:

- Collaborate with the engineering team of a partner company to design, develop, and maintain software solutions.
- Build scalable and efficient applications.
- Leverage knowledge of Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning to enhance project outcomes.
- Participate in code reviews, testing, and debugging to ensure high-quality deliverables.
- Work closely with stakeholders to understand project goals and align technical solutions accordingly.


Preferred Qualifications:

- Master’s student or graduate in Computer Science or a related field.
- Knowledge of Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning is a plus.
- Passion for leveraging technology to create meaningful social impact.
- Strong communication and teamwork skills.


What You’ll Gain:

- Opportunity to work on real-world projects with a tangible impact on underrepresented communities.Experience collaborating with industry professionals through CLTI’s partner network.
- Networking opportunities with tech leaders and peers passionate about social impact.
- Recognition for your contribution to a nonprofit cause.
fit_why: Volunteer pro-bono role; general SWE with AI/ML a plus

jd:
Why Ryan?



- Competitively Paid Internship
- Award-Winning Culture
- Paid Holidays
- Mentorship Opportunities and Hands-On Training
- Networking with Industry Leaders
- All-Expense-Paid Trip to Ryan Headquarters in Dallas, TX (Summer Interns Only)

As a Software Engineering Intern, you will collaborate with experienced technology professionals on software development projects supporting our Unclaimed Property practice. You'll gain hands-on experience working with technologies such as .NET, C#, React, TypeScript, and Microsoft Azure, with potential exposure to Python. You'll contribute to real-world projects while also having the opportunity to take ownership of smaller development tasks from start to finish, building your technical skills and gaining valuable experience throughout the software development lifecycle.

Duties And Responsibilities



- Collaborate with experienced technology professionals on software engineering projects supporting Ryan's Unclaimed Property practice.
- Assist in developing, testing, and enhancing software applications and features using technologies such as .NET, C#, React, TypeScript, and Microsoft Azure, with potential exposure to Python.
- Take ownership of smaller development tasks from start to finish, with guidance and support from experienced engineers.
- Participate in troubleshooting, debugging, and testing to improve application functionality and performance.
- Work closely with team members to understand project requirements, contribute ideas, and implement technical solutions.
- Gain hands-on experience throughout the software development lifecycle, including development, testing, and deployment.
- Participate in team meetings, code reviews, and collaborative problem-solving to further develop technical skills and knowledge.

Education And Experience



- Working toward a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Data Engineering, Artificial Intelligence, or related study. 
- Anticipated graduation date within one year of internship
- Minimum Overall and Major GPA of 2.8
- Minimum of 6 – 12 Technical credit hours depending on practice

Professional Skills Requirements



- Work effectively in a fast pace, high-energy environment.
- Strong problem solving, attention to detail, and communication skills.
- Ability to prioritize tasks, work on multiple assignments, and manage ambiguity.
- Ability to work both independently and as part of a team with professionals at all levels.
- Intermediate knowledge of all Microsoft Office applications, Outlook, and etc.

Computer Skills

To perform this job successfully, an individual must have intermediate knowledge of Microsoft® Word, Access, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook, and Internet navigation and research.

Certificates And Licenses

Valid driver's license required.

Supervisory Responsibilities

This position has no supervisory responsibilities.

Equal Opportunity Employer: disability/veteran
fit_why: .NET/C# stack is new to him; React/TypeScript and Azure overlap partly

jd:
Why Ryan?



- Competitively Paid Internship
- Award-Winning Culture
- Paid Holidays
- Mentorship Opportunities and Hands-On Training
- Networking with Industry Leaders
- All-Expense-Paid Trip to Ryan Headquarters in Dallas, TX (Summer Interns Only)

Ryan is looking for software engineering interns to help build the platform capabilities that enable development teams across the firm to deliver applications addressing our clients' needs. Our engineering teams support Tax.com, the technology engine powering Ryan's tax teams.

You will contribute to shared services, Portal experiences, reusable components, and developer tools while gaining hands-on experience with cloud solutions. Working alongside engineers and collaborating with product and design, you will learn how enterprise applications are developed, tested, secured, and delivered. You will use AI tools to accelerate learning, prototype ideas, and rapidly iterate as you contribute to a defined engineering project.

Our primary technologies are .NET and C#, React and TypeScript, and Microsoft Azure, with some exposure to Python.

Duties And Responsibilities



- Develop and improve software features, shared services, reusable application components, or developer tools with guidance from experienced engineers. 
- Build and integrate APIs, shared libraries, and React single-page applications that support multiple Ryan development teams. 
- Explore Microsoft Azure services and contribute to development, testing, or deployment workflows. 
- Use AI tools to accelerate learning, prototyping, coding, and debugging; review and validate your work with the team. 
- Write automated tests, investigate defects, and participate in code reviews to improve software quality and reliability. 
- Collaborate with engineering, product, and design to understand user needs, demonstrate progress, and incorporate feedback. 
- Document what you build so other teams can understand, adopt, and maintain it.

Education And Experience



- Working toward a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Management Information Systems, or related study. 
- Programming coursework or experience building software through class projects, personal projects, open-source contributions, or prior work.
- Anticipated graduation date within one year of internship
- Minimum Overall and Major GPA of 2.8
- Minimum of 6 – 12 Technical credit hours depending on practice
- Tax or accounting experience is not required.

Professional Skills Requirements



- Strong problem-solving skills, attention to detail, curiosity, and a willingness to learn. 
- Ability to explain your work, ask questions, respond to feedback, and collaborate with teammates. 
- Ability to organize tasks, manage ambiguity, and make progress in a fast-moving engineering team. 
- Ability to work independently on a defined task and seek guidance when needed.

Computer Skills

Basic understanding of programming and debugging is expected. Familiarity with C#/.NET, React, TypeScript, Git, APIs, automated testing, Azure, or AI development tools is helpful. Exposure to Python is a plus.

Certificates And Licenses

Valid driver's license required.

Supervisory Responsibilities

This position has no supervisory responsibilities.

Equal Opportunity Employer: disability/veteran
fit_why: Core web/full-stack intern role; C#/.NET and Azure are gaps
